selection_rule.anchor_eligibility: Reference and query anchors must be a direct target-building pair from the frozen candidate ledger, use distinct collections, have strict explicit-zero pose projection, and not overlap any prior router item or excluded target way.
selection_rule.ordering: For each producer stratum in the fixed order, walk the already frozen direct-candidate ledger order and select the first anchor pair whose exact reciprocal reference-next and query-prev/query-next all remain in the anchor collections, link reciprocally, pass strict explicit-zero projection, and do not overlap prior items.
selection_rule.metadata_failure_policy: A candidate failing linked metadata is recorded and skipped before any selected pixel exists. Once a metadata-valid candidate is selected for a stratum, no pixel-driven substitution or resampling is allowed.
selection_rule.pixel_boundary: All ten anchors and neighbours for selected rows remain undownloaded and human/model unseen at freeze. The first five earlier federated-source targets are excluded because their anchors were previously materialized and reviewed.
